mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate valuation.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings contraction, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate increase (>0.3pp) and industrial production decline (>0.5 points) indicate broad economic contraction, causing equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and INDPRO falls > 0.5 points in last month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, housing starts exceeding 1200 thousand units signal excessive credit growth and overheating, prompting central bank tightening that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of late-cycle instances when HOUST > 1200, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) reflects robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through near-term economic momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 55% of INDPRO increase instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate investment.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 55% of FEDFUNDS > 4.5 instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increase (>0.25pp) and unemployment rate decline (>0.2pp) signal strong labor market driving monetary tightening, which raises equity discount rates and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp and UNRATE falls > 0.2pp in last month
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicate sustained consumer spending strength that supports corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through durable demand momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 55% of RSAFS increase instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.
